page_title: MON 0-0 FRE | B. Monchengladbach v Freiburg 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Daniel Schlager has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' PENALTY APPEAL after Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+2' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
90' Julian Schuster isn't happy on the touchline after referee Daniel Schlager shows him a yellow card.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
87' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jan Urbich for Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
83' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and the ball goes to the top of the goal.Moritz Nicolas is alert and pulls off a save to deflect the ball onto the bar.
82' Daniel Schlager shows a yellow card to Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) for a tough tackle.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) will replace Florian Neuhaus.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Philipp Sander trots off the pitch and is replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Jan-Niklas Beste and he is replaced by Eren Dinkci (Freiburg).
79' The substitution has been made. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) has replaced Junior Adamu.

75' A neat pass is well received by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
73' B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.

73' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Noah Atubolu is alert and denies him with a nice save. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
72' B. Monchengladbach are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
69' Eugen Polanski decides to make a substitution. Rocco Reitz will be replaced by Oscar Fraulo (B. Monchengladbach).
69' Substitution. Haris Tabakovic will be replaced by Jan Urbich (B. Monchengladbach).
68' A clumsy foul by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.

66' What a chance that is! Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
66' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

66' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Free kick. Freiburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
64' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniel Schlager ignores the protests.
63' Vincenzo Grifo will be replaced by Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
61' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) commits a rough foul. Daniel Schlager stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to B. Monchengladbach.

60' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
59' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach).
58' B. Monchengladbach control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch so that Luca Netz can be given a rest.

57' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
54' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) earns the yellow card.

49' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julian Schuster probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lucas Holer (Freiburg). He is replaced by Johan Manzambi.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' It looks like Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Schlager won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Freiburg.

45' A rebound falls kindly for Christian Gunter (Freiburg), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
44' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
43' Great touch by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
43' 2:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
41' One of the B. Monchengladbach players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
39' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach.

36' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
34' Freiburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' A neat pass is well received by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
29' B. Monchengladbach failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.
27' Great teamplay by B. Monchengladbach as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:1.
21' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
17' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
17' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' B. Monchengladbach are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
12' 32:68 – the latest ball possession ratio.

8' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman signals a throw-in for B. Monchengladbach.
4' Neat passing move from Freiburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager is introduced as the referee for today's match.
